source_documents.title: Supramolecular Aggregation-Induced Emission Nanodots with Programmed Tumor Microenvironment Responsiveness for Image-Guided Orthotopic Pancreatic Cancer Therapy

reference_evidence_units.quote: when increasing the water fraction from 0% to 70%, the maximal PL red-shifted gradually from ~600 to ~645 nm along with an intensity decrease
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR
reference_evidence_units.statement: Low-to-intermediate water fractions red-shift and weaken emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Polarity and solubility co-vary; no numeric quantum yield is reported.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The PL intensity greatly intensified in high water fractions (80% and 90%) because of the aggregates formation restricting the intramolecular motion of TPR.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign high-water emission enhancement to aggregation-induced restriction of motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Motion restriction is inferred rather than directly measured.

reference_evidence_units.quote: formation of large aggregates offering a hydrophobic microenvironment against water invasion, thus reducing TICT effect.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hydrophobic aggregate interior is proposed to reduce TICT, explaining blue-shifted aggregate emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No measured microenvironment polarity or TICT torsional surface.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the LUMO was primarily distributed on the rhodanine- 3-acetic acid
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR
reference_evidence_units.statement: HOMO is mainly on methoxy-TPE and LUMO on rhodanine-acetic acid; the structure is twisted.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state orbital separation supports D-A character, not a quantitatively resolved TICT rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: each α-CD had one TPR group or one GEM group attached via triethylenetetramine.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Covalently conjugated TPR in alpha-CD-TPR
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text NMR interpretation referring to SI S5-S8.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPR is covalently attached to alpha-CD; it is not the PEG guest threaded through its cavity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This material is a TPR derivative, not chemically identical free TPR; SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The successful inclusion complexation between α-CD and PEG chain could be proved by 2D 1H NOESY spectrum
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR-bearing alpha-CD/PEG nanoparticle assembly
reference_evidence_units.conditions: NOESY evidence reported in main for SI S14; PEG/inside-CD proximity.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Host-guest interaction is alpha-CD/PEG, forming the TPR-containing fluorescent assembly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: System-level evidence only; no direct free-TPR inclusion and SI spectrum not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the PL peaks of α-CD-TPR-GEM-mmp(+) NPs and bare TPR were both at 630 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR and TPR-bearing nanoparticles
reference_evidence_units.statement: Both bare aggregated TPR and formulated nanoparticles are reported to peak at 630 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Matching peaks do not prove binding geometry or a host-induced quantum-yield change.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The electropositive R8 shell could hence accelerate the cellular internalization of the NPs, resulting in higher intracellular FR/NIR fluorescence of TPR.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPR-bearing mmp(+) nanoparticles versus mmp(-) control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BxPC-3 cells, 2 h and 5 h incubation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increased cellular signal is assigned to uptake following peptide deshielding.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is delivery-mediated intensity, not intrinsic TPR turn-on or a photoinduced electron-transfer reaction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: without DTT treatment, the release of GEM from α-CD-TPR-GEM-mmp(+) NPs was slow and scarce with less than 20% release after 96 h.
reference_evidence_units.subject: GEM cargo in TPR-containing formulation
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reductive cleavage controls GEM release; no-DTT release stays below 20% at 96 h.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: GEM release is not a TPR excited-state mechanism; no triplet/PET label follows.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The explicit source AIE explanation is restricted intramolecular motion in TPR aggregates.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Bare TPR aggregates provide the source-proposed restrictive, hydrophobic environment; derivative nanoparticle inclusion is not required for this target-level proposal.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source assigns solution quenching and spectral shifts to TICT, with aggregate hydrophobicity reducing it.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The explicit source AIE explanation is restricted intramolecular motion in TPR aggregates.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Bare TPR aggregates provide the source-proposed restrictive, hydrophobic environment; derivative nanoparticle inclusion is not required for this target-level proposal.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The demonstrated host-guest pair is alpha-CD/PEG in a covalently modified TPR formulation. It does not establish host-guest binding or host-induced emission of the free TPR target. Retain the derivative findings as comparator context.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source assigns solution quenching and spectral shifts to TICT, with aggregate hydrophobicity reducing it.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state mechanism established beyond generic changes in fluorescence intensity.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
